_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Serp del jogaire sus un grillat {width}×{height}.
Controlatz la serp {player_id}. Movements valables: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (o w/s/a/d).
Objectiu: subreviure mai longtemps o èsser lo mai long e obtenir lo puntatge mai naut (limita de torns {max_turns} torns).

game_action.invalid_death: Serpent {player_id} moriguèt a causa d'un movement invalid.

outcome.survived_win: Lo jogaire {player_id} subrevisquèt; totes los autres moriguèron.
outcome.outlived: Lo jogaire a subreviscut totes los autres.
outcome.turn_limit: Limite de virada atengut - lo melhor score ganha l'estagi.
